theorems.name: Submission.idtp_fons_odc_ray_action
theorems.statement: ∀ (P : ℕ) (R : IMRep (univ : Set (Euclid P)) 1) (F : Finset (Euclid P)), (∀ e ∈ F, ‖e‖ = 1) → (μHE[1] : Measure (Euclid P)) (R.carrier ∩ (⋃ e ∈ F, (fun t : ℝ => t • e) '' Ioi 0)ᶜ) = 0 → ∃ g : Euclid P → ℝ → ℝ, (∀ e ∈ F, LocallyIntegrableOn (g e) (Ioi 0)) ∧ (∀ e ∈ F, ∀ᵐ t ∂(volume.restrict (Ioi (0 : ℝ))), ∃ k : ℤ, g e t = k) ∧ ∀ ω : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) 1, R.action (ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) 1) = ∑ e ∈ F, ∫ t in Ioi (0 : ℝ), g e t * (ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) 1) (t • e) (fun _ => e)
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
